title: Kielikaveri card schema
description: Note format. See cards/instructions.md for how to fill it in. Single source of truth for the schema - the bot (phase 1+) imports this file, it does not redefine the format.

formsSource.description: fst = every principal form resolved to exactly one FST candidate. fst+llm = at least one form had several FST candidates and an LLM (or a human, in phase 0) must pick one. llm = FST produced nothing for at least one form.

lemma.description: Dictionary form for kind=word. The construction itself for kind=pattern, e.g. 'selvitä + -ssa/-ssä' - case as its ending, not its name (see cards/instructions.md; partitiivi/illatiivi are the exception, no single ending).

principal_forms.description: Verb keys: preesens_1s, preesens_3s, imperfekti_3s, konditionaali_1s, imperatiivi_2s, nut_partisiippi, passiivi. Noun/adjective keys: nominatiivi, genetiivi, partitiivi, illatiivi, inessiivi, elatiivi, adessiivi, ablatiivi, allatiivi, essiivi, translatiivi, monikon_genetiivi, monikon_partitiivi. All values must come from generate_forms() - never hand-written.

forms_verified.description: false means principal_forms must not be used in inflection exercises (phase 2+).

rektio.description: Verb government, e.g. 'pitää + -sta/-stä' - case as its ending, not its name (see cards/instructions.md; partitiivi/illatiivi are the exception, no single ending).

puhekieli.description: Colloquial form. Not FST-validated - puhekieli falls outside literary FST norms.
